## Software requirements

Use R 4.4 or later. Install the required packages with:

```r
install.packages(c(
  "dplyr", "ggplot2", "ggpubr", "here", "purrr", "rdecision",
  "readr", "scales", "stringr", "tibble", "tidyr", "tidyverse"
))
```

Open `Econ_Model_Thalassaemia.Rproj` or run commands from the repository root.

## Analysis sequence

```sh
Rscript analysis/01_baseline_analysis.R
Rscript analysis/02_deterministic_sensitivity_analysis.R
Rscript analysis/03_probabilistic_sensitivity_analysis.R
Rscript analysis/04_extract_uncertainty_results.R
Rscript analysis/05_budget_impact_analysis.R
Rscript analysis/06_prevalence_analysis.R
Rscript tests/verify_results.R
```

`04_extract_uncertainty_results.R` sources the PSA analysis internally, so it
is not necessary to run script 03 separately when only the uncertainty tables
are required.

## Reproducible PSA options

The default PSA uses 1,000 simulations and seed 20260804. Override them before
sourcing the extraction script:

```r
options(
  thalassaemia.psa_iterations = 10000L,
  thalassaemia.psa_seed = 20260804L
)
source("analysis/04_extract_uncertainty_results.R")
```
